skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of unstructured data and NoSQL databases, classify different types of NoSQL databases, and choose appropriate databases for application development.
Apply MongoDB in designing software applications, particularly smart applications.
Execute queries and manage data in MongoDB and other NoSQL databases such as Neo4j, Cassandra, and Redis.
Manage cloud-based MongoDB Atlas and other cloud databases.
Create and manage indexes in MongoDB and other NoSQL databases.
Develop problem-solving skills related to unstructured data management.
Work effectively in teams to solve problems and present solutions using NoSQL technologies.
Develop the ability to work independently and responsibly.
Present and defend solutions and ideas in front of a group.
Manage and complete group projects on time.
